caption:
Instead of placing your baby directly into tummy time, try rolling them into it. 💛

That gentle transition helps your baby ease into the position while giving them a chance to practice the motor patterns that eventually lead to rolling independently. Once they're settled, the Look at Me Ladybug gives them something engaging to focus on, helping encourage those extra moments of tummy time that build strength over time. 🐞

Small shifts in how we support development can make a big difference over time. 

💬Need more support with your baby’s tummy time? Drop your questions below!
